title: Divide a whole number
summary: Assembly: Divide a whole number. Try 9 divided by 3.
introduction: div divides rdx:rax by its input. For this small positive example, clear rdx first.
learningObjectives: Divide a whole number with Assembly

blocks.text: On x86-64 Linux, save lesson.asm. Run nasm -f elf64 lesson.asm -o lesson.o, then ld lesson.o -o lesson. Run ./lesson, then printf 'exit code: %s\n' "$?" immediately.

blocks.title: Divide a whole number
blocks.code:
global _start
section .text
_start:
    mov rax, 8
    xor rdx, rdx
    mov rbx, 3
    div rbx
    mov rdi, rax
    mov rax, 60
    syscall

blocks.text: rdx is cleared so the dividend is 8. Division by 3 leaves quotient 2 in rax.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Never divide by zero. The remainder is in rdx, not rax.
